tests.title: Case 1 - Rotation is enabled when two monomers without bonds are selected
Case 2 - Rotation is enabled when two monomers with a bond are selected
Case 3 - Rotation is enabled when more than two monomers are selected, bonded or not
Case 4 - Rotation is not enabled when only one monomer is selected
Case 5 - Bounding box with rotation handle and center cross appears when two or more monomers are selected
Case 6 - Rotation, flip and delete buttons are shown above the bounding box
Case 7 - Rotation angles are displayed near the bounding box while rotating
Case 8 - Default rotation angle step is 15 degrees
Case 9 - Rotation mode is activated by pressing the left mouse button on the handle
Case 10 - Selected fragment stays in new position after rotation mode is deactivated
Case 11 - Flip horizontally, flip vertically and delete buttons work as expected
Case 12 - Circle center is the center of rotation and its diameter equals the bounding box height
Case 13 - Predefined angles are marked on the rotation circle
Case 14 - Set of angles always covers the range [-90, +90] relative to the handle position
Case 15 - Current rotation angle is displayed at the starting position
Case 16 - Center of rotation can be moved
